The '''Chommell system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that saw a number of guerrilla attacks on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] convoys by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The pirates were eventually tracked to a number of bases in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and eliminated.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Hit and Run}}</ref>
